description: This Python source file defines a DTMF (Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency) aggregation processor class for converting keypad inputs into transcription frames, intended for downstream processing by language models. It handles DTMF input frames, manages timeouts, and emits transcription frames with aggregated keypad sequences.

classes.name: DTMFAggregator
classes.description: A frame processor that aggregates DTMF keypad inputs into sequences and converts them into transcription frames for downstream language model processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DTMF aggregator with optional timeout, termination digit, and prefix.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the aggregation task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling DTMF input, start, end, and cancel frames.

methods.name: _handle_dtmf_frame
methods.description: Handles individual DTMF input frames, updating aggregation and triggering flushes.

methods.name: _create_aggregation_task
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task for timeout-based aggregation.

methods.name: _aggregation_task_handler
methods.description: Background task that waits for digit events or timeout to trigger aggregation flush.

methods.name: _flush_aggregation
methods.description: Emits a transcription frame with the current DTMF sequence and resets the aggregation.
